summary: Python CLI generates pre-existing candidate delta JSON; required args: repository root, baseline commit, candidate commit, one or more repository-relative paths, output path; paths sorted/deduplicated and reject absolute or parent traversal; reads blobs via git show and fails if absent; records normalized path, baseline/candidate SHA-256, disposition pre-existing-regression-or-repair-input; schema toolchain-workflow-repair.pre-existing-delta.v1; includes commits, generator ID, empty authorizes list; creates parent directory, writes sorted indented UTF-8 JSON with LF newline; prints pass status, output, count; exits 0 on success
